proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Dual Class Capital Structure
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc. Funded Pension Plan; Comptroller of the State of New York, Thomas P. DiNapoli, Trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board initiate a recapitalization plan giving all outstanding stock one vote per share through a phase-out of Class B disproportionate voting rights within seven years.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Generative AI Misinformation and Disinformation Risks
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital on behalf of John B. Alexander; Open MIC on behalf of Marguerite Casey Foundation and The Woodcock Foundation; Mary Hawkins
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing risks to company operations, finances and public welfare from generative AI misinformation and disinformation, with remediation steps and effectiveness measures.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Disclosure of Voting Results Based on Class of Shares
proposals.proponent: Treasurer for the State of Illinois and Trustee of the Bright Start College Savings Trust; Schroder Investment Management Limited; Wespath Benefits and Investments
proposals.topic_summary: Requests disclosure of voting results separately for shares with one vote and shares with multiple votes beginning at the 2025 annual meeting.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Human Rights Risks in Non-US Markets
proposals.proponent: AkademikerPension on behalf of Kapitalforeningen MP Invest; Storebrand Asset Management AS; Amundi Asset Management; Christina O'Connell on behalf of Mari Mennel-Bell
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on measures to prevent hate speech, disinformation and incitement to violence in the five largest non-US markets, including moderator language data and independent assessment.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Amendment of Corporate Governance Guidelines
proposals.proponent: The Shareholder Association for Research & Education (SHARE) on behalf of The Pension Fund of The United Church of Canada
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending Corporate Governance Guidelines so both the Chairperson and the Lead Independent Director can independently place items on board meeting agendas.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Human Rights Impact Assessment on AI Systems Driving Targeted Advertising
proposals.proponent: Mercy Investment Services, Inc.; NEI Investments
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party human rights impact assessment of AI systems driving targeted advertising, published by June 1, 2025.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Child Safety Impacts and Actual Harm Reduction to Children
proposals.proponent: Proxy Impact on behalf of the Lisette Cooper 2015 Trust and the Linda C. Wisnewski Trust; Durocher Fund; Sisters of the Holy Names of Jesus and Mary U.S.-Ontario Province; CommonSpirit Health; The Maryknoll Sisters of St. Dominic, Inc.; The Domestic and Foreign Missionary Society of the Protestant Episcopal Church; Providence St. Joseph Health; Adrian Dominican Sisters
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board adopt quantitative child safety and harm reduction targets and publish an annual report measuring performance.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report and Advisory Vote on Minimum Age for Social Media
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party report on risks and benefits of a higher minimum age for social media users, followed by an advisory shareholder vote on raising it.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Political Advertising and Election Cycle Enhanced Actions
proposals.proponent: As You Sow on behalf of Thomas Van Dyck
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing benefits and drawbacks of prohibiting all political advertising and restoring 2020 election cycle enhanced actions to reduce amplification of false information.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Framework to Assess Company Lobbying Alignment with Climate Goals
proposals.proponent: The Presbyterian Church (USA); Portico Benefit Services
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on the framework for identifying and addressing misalignment between Meta's lobbying activities and its Net Zero climate commitments.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.
